subject: planner: fix prune `null` value in `in` function for range partition (#61807)
summary: Reviewed this commit’s planner-only diff vs first parent: it stops treating `NULL` items inside `IN (...)` as requiring partition 0 for RANGE/RANGE COLUMNS pruning. This matches SQL semantics (`x IN (..., NULL)` is never TRUE solely because of NULL) and reduces unnecessary partition scans; empty-range propagation is safe (handled by `simplify`/`intersection` and results in `LogicalTableDual` via `makeUnionAllChildren`). Checked later upstream history (file moved under `pkg/planner/core/rule/` but NULL-skipping logic remains); no remaining Blocker/High issues found.
